summary.text: Ron Mendive represents Idaho House District 5, Seat A, according to the Idaho Legislature's 2026 membership directory, which lists Coeur d'Alene as the legislator's city.

paragraphs.text: The directory biography says Mendive was born in Elko, Nevada, and graduated from Kellogg High School and North Idaho College.
It also lists Mendive as a principal in a corporation that developed a self-igniting pellet stove.

sources.title: Idaho House of Representatives membership directory (2026 session)
